sequence_description: SAML assertion without <Conditions> (no audience/time bounds) should be rejected; if accepted, broker grants a session without upstream intent constraints.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_i5_saml_nocond_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_i5_saml_nocond_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted SAML assertion without <Conditions>; session granted without upstream audience/time constraints (authorization binding violated).

sequence_description: SAML assertion with mismatched AudienceRestriction should be rejected; if accepted, broker grants session beyond upstream intent (audience binding failure).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_wrong_aud_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_wrong_aud_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: authentik accepted a SAML assertion with an AudienceRestriction for a different SP audience, granting a session beyond upstream intent (audience binding failure).

sequence_description: Expired SAML assertion should be rejected; if accepted, broker grants a session beyond upstream intent time bounds (authorization binding failure). Includes control valid SAML login first.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_i5_saml_control_login_status < 400 AND user_i5_saml_expired_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: (user_i5_saml_control_login_status=200 < 400 → True) AND (user_i5_saml_expired_login_status=200 >= 400 → False)
Implication: SP accepted an expired SAML assertion (time-bound upstream intent not enforced), granting a session beyond allowed authorization context.
